# Global Legal Insights reports on Burford's energy transition research


November 14, 2024


-
-
-
-


Global Legal Insights reports on Burford's[latest research](https://www.burfordcapital.com/insights-news-events/insights-research/2024-energy-transition-research/) , which, as the article notes, reveals that "A total of 63% of general counsels reported that they expect legal fees and expenses to reach over USD 4 million per energy transition case, while 29% estimated costs to rise above USD 10 million."


[Click here to read the full article.](https://www.globallegalinsights.com/news/energy-transition-disputes-on-the-rise/)
